notes: SPTrans GTFS is frequency-based (≈40 k frequency rows) and has no calendar_dates: Pathfinder applies its own holiday table.
Metrô and CPTM lines are route shells in the SPTrans feed (type 1 / 2); ARTESP intercity buses (ex-EMTU) are not in this bundle.
Olho Vivo needs the user's own token (Settings); without it the city is timetable-only.
Live data needs a key: SPTrans Olho Vivo token (live buses and predictions) (https://www.sptrans.com.br/desenvolvedores/cadastro-desenvolvedores/).
